title: WaterPilot Metric Registry
description: Machine-readable companion to docs/domain/metrics.md. All definitions are PROPOSED pending domain review. Equations must not be altered to reproduce screenshot example numbers.
nullRule: A missing/unverified input, or a zero denominator, yields availability 'unavailable' — never 0 or a fabricated value.

precision.rawValues: Exact rationals, integer base units, or decimal with 28 significant digits; no binary float; no intermediate rounding except money quantized to integer paise per cash-flow line item per period.
precision.goldenRepresentation: Exact decimal string (e.g. '10.1') or reduced fraction (e.g. '27/101').
precision.comparisonTolerance: Exact rational equality; a 28-digit Decimal approximation of a non-terminating value must be within 1e-20 of the exact value.
precision.displayRounding: Applied only at the presentation boundary, ROUND_HALF_EVEN; never fed back into computation.

windowKinds.calendar_year: [start, start + 1 calendar year): 365 or 366 days; 29 Feb start rejected
windowKinds.fixed_days: [start, start + N days) with explicit N

methodTypes.deterministic: Computable now from validated inputs by pure engine code.
methodTypes.requires_local_measurement: Needs in-situ/local data; not inferable from imagery.
methodTypes.requires_reviewed_model: Needs an explicit, domain-reviewed response relationship.

metrics.name: Demand
metrics.nullSemantics: unavailable if population or per-capita standard missing

metrics.name: Delivered supply
metrics.nullSemantics: provisional with named missing source; missing source is NOT treated as 0
metrics.accountingBoundary: source inflow into distribution, before storage; not demand-serving supply (served_supply_day = min(delivered_supply_day, demand_day))

metrics.name: Reliable supply (dependable yield)
metrics.nullSemantics: unavailable if series too short/incomplete to estimate exceedance at p

metrics.name: Dependable-supply ratio
metrics.note: Not capped at 1. Not volume reliability (fixture 80% vs 94%) and not time reliability (70%).
metrics.nullSemantics: unavailable if either input unavailable or mean demand is 0

metrics.name: Deficit (reliable-supply basis)
metrics.nullSemantics: unavailable if either input unavailable; never 0 by default

metrics.name: Shortage-day count
metrics.nullSemantics: unavailable if series does not cover window

metrics.name: Days until shortage (lead time)
metrics.formula: min{ day - reference_date : day >= reference_date, delivered_supply_day < demand_day }
metrics.nullSemantics: unavailable if no forward series; '>= horizon' if no shortage in horizon (not 0)

metrics.name: Volume reliability
metrics.nullSemantics: unavailable if demand total is 0 or series incomplete

metrics.name: Time reliability
metrics.formula: count{ day : delivered_supply_day >= demand_day } / count{ day in window }
metrics.nullSemantics: unavailable if series incomplete or window has zero days

metrics.name: Tanker dependence
metrics.note: A share, not a day-count. Screenshot label in 'days' is an inconsistency (see metrics.md C3).
metrics.nullSemantics: unavailable if tanker contribution or total supply unavailable, or if total delivered supply is 0 (undefined share, not 0%)

metrics.name: Project cost (capital)
metrics.formula: sum(capital_cost_intervention) with per-item source and basis date
metrics.note: O&M tracked as a separate annual series, not folded into capital.
metrics.nullSemantics: unavailable if any selected intervention lacks a costed basis

displayRounding.note: display only; raw value is integer paise

metrics.name: Avoided cost
metrics.nullSemantics: unavailable if avoided volume or unit price unverified; label 'illustrative estimate' only when inputs are explicit assumptions

displayRounding.note: display only; raw value is integer paise

metrics.name: Net benefit
metrics.note: Funding/grants are NOT added here (they change who pays, not economic benefit).

displayRounding.note: display only; raw value is integer paise

metrics.name: Payback period
metrics.formula: first period cumulative_cashflow >= 0; interpolate within year; months = round(years*12)
metrics.specialValue: no_payback if cumulative never reaches 0 within horizon
metrics.nullSemantics: unavailable if cash flows unavailable; 'no_payback' (not 0, not large number) if never breaks even, including net annual benefit <= 0; 0 months only when project_cost = 0
metrics.rawValue: exact years and months (e.g. 20/7 years, 240/7 months); integer months is the display value

metrics.name: Average daily supply gap
metrics.nullSemantics: unavailable if demand or complete supply is unknown; never zero by default

indicators.name: Rainfall over the reporting window
indicators.nullSemantics: unavailable if any day in the window is missing, the unit is not mm, or the window is empty

indicators.name: Groundwater pumped (mean per day)
indicators.note: Pumped volume into supply; says nothing about aquifer level.
indicators.nullSemantics: unavailable if any day in the window is missing, the unit is not L/day, or the window is empty

indicators.name: Latest groundwater level
indicators.formula: last observed level in the window, with its date
indicators.nullSemantics: unavailable if no reading in the window or the unit is not m_bgl

indicators.name: Latest surface-water extent
indicators.formula: last observed extent in the window, with its date
indicators.nullSemantics: unavailable if no observation in the window or the unit is not m2

indicators.name: Latest water-quality reading per parameter
indicators.unit: per parameter (mg/L, NTU, uS/cm, pH, CFU/100mL)
indicators.formula: last sample per parameter in the window, with its date; never combined into an index
indicators.nullSemantics: unavailable per parameter if no sample in the window or the unit is not a reviewed quality unit

indicators.name: Flood-risk category
indicators.formula: category from a reviewed hazard layer
indicators.nullSemantics: unavailable: categorical layers are not summarized by the baseline yet

indicators.name: Land-cover category
indicators.nullSemantics: unavailable: categorical layers are not summarized by the baseline yet

indicatorsNote: Context indicators shown beside the baseline (ADR 0010). Descriptive only: they never feed a metric and are never combined into a score. Shown only when the capability passes the readiness gate and the variable's normalized unit matches.
